## feature

<!-- new capability this task added -->

### per-position depth and error rates in error.parquet

```
level: high
```

#### reason

A cross-validation test runs real `samtools depth -J -a -a` on a fixture BAM and asserts the `total` column equals its output; 150 tests, ruff, and pyright pass.

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

1. `error.parquet` grows 10 → 19 columns: `total` (per-position depth) plus `insertion_rate`, `deletion_rate`, `smoothed_deletion_rate`, `mismatch_rate`, `to_a_rate`, `to_c_rate`, `to_g_rate`, `to_t_rate`, each `count / total`.
2. `total` follows `samtools depth -J -a -a` semantics verified from primary source (`bam2depth.c:744,775,853,396`): deletions count as covered, insertions do not; over sam-tagger's read universe (all mapped cs-carrying reads), not region-gated.
3. Rates are `0.0` on zero depth (the `fl_pct` precedent); `smoothed_deletion_rate` is null without `--fasta`.
4. Always on — no new CLI flag; computed from the cs walk the tally already does.

#### before

error.parquet carried counts only; per-position rates required joining an external samtools depth output, whose default read filter (secondary/dup/qcfail excluded) mismatches the numerators' universe.

#### after

Counts and a self-consistent denominator live in one file; `-J` semantics keep every rate ≤ 1 (the read deleting at p is itself in the denominator at p).

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

- `src/sam_tagger/stats/error_stats.py:56-58` — `depth_diff` on `_PerRefErrorStats`.
- `src/sam_tagger/stats/error_stats.py` — `_bump_depth` calls in the `:`/`*`/`-` branches (the `-J` line commented).
- `src/sam_tagger/stats/error_stats.py` — `_bump_depth`/`_depth_array` (difference array, prefix sum).
- `src/sam_tagger/stats/error_stats.py` — `_write_error_stats` computes rates and emits 19 columns.
- `src/sam_tagger/parquet_writer.py` — 19-column `PositionalErrorStats`.
- `tests/test_stats.py` — 5 depth/rate tests; `tests/test_integration.py:506-545` — the samtools parity test.
- Semantics source: `/bioproj/tools/github/samtools/bam2depth.c` (cloned this session, line-cited in the assessment).

:::

## fix

None

## limitation

### parity with samtools is conditional; intron cs ops unparsed

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

Both facts are structural: `bam2depth.c:744` excludes secondary/dup/qcfail by default while our universe keeps them (for numerator/denominator consistency), and `CS_REGEX` has no `~` alternative — both documented in the user docs.

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

1. `total == samtools depth -J -a -a` exactly when the BAM has no secondary (0x100) / QC-fail (0x200) / dup (0x400) records and every mapped read carries `cs`; otherwise the columns differ by design (rate denominators must match numerators).
2. Spliced reads (`~` intron ops) mis-walk positions after the intron — pre-existing limitation, unchanged by this feature; amplicon data is unaffected.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

- `/bioproj/tools/github/samtools/bam2depth.c:744` — the default flag filter.
- `src/sam_tagger/processing.py:28` — `CS_REGEX` without `~`.
- `docs/usage.qmd` — the parity conditions paragraph.

:::

## caveat

### rates use sam-tagger's universe, not samtools' default filter

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

The choice is deliberate and documented; the parity test demonstrates the equivalence domain on a clean fixture.

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

1. Do not join our `total` onto files expecting samtools' default-filtered depth when secondary/dup/qcfail records exist.
2. To reproduce our numbers with samtools: `samtools depth -J -a -a --excl-flags 0x4`.

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [text]
```

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}

- `tests/test_integration.py` — `test_error_stats_total_matches_samtools_depth` (fixture without secondary/dup/qcfail; exact equality asserted).

:::

## assumption

### rate-at-zero-depth convention and column set fit downstream consumers

```
level: medium
```

#### reason

The user chose the total + all-8-rates option; the `0.0`-on-zero-depth convention follows the `fl_pct` house precedent. I have not seen the consuming model.

#### description

```
type: [text]
```

1. If a consumer prefers null over 0.0 at zero depth, the convention is a single expression per rate in `_write_error_stats`.

## conclusion

### the missing denominator is delivered, tested against real samtools

```
level: high
```

#### reason

The parity claim is executable, not aspirational: the test suite invokes samtools and asserts equality.

#### description

```
type: [statistic]
```

1. 150 tests pass (144 before; 6 new/extended), ruff and pyright clean.
2. Cost matches the assessment: 2 dict updates per covering cs op, prefix sum and 8 divisions per position at write — same class as the existing tally; no new inputs for `total` (the rates' only dependency, `--fasta`, was already shipped for smoothing).

#### evidence

```
level: high
type: [statistic]
```

```text
pixi run -e dev lint      → All checks passed!
pixi run -e dev typecheck → 0 errors, 0 warnings, 0 informations
parity: total == samtools depth -J -a -a (fixture without 0x100/0x200/0x400)
```

:::
